sentences.en: Better to extend an olive branch than launch a missile.
sentences.zh: 最好伸出橄榄枝，而不是发射导弹。

sentences.en: Iran has missiles that could destroy facilities in neighboring countries.
sentences.zh: 伊朗拥有能够摧毁邻国设施的导弹。

sentences.en: A Ukrainian airliner was shot down by an Iranian missile.
sentences.zh: 一架乌克兰客机被伊朗导弹击落。

senses.zh: 导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的
